architecture.realExchangeValidation: MirrorExchange requires finite PRE/POST points, an exact active Mirror A2 owning cast, and the exact live Mirror/opponent actor pair; invalid, stale, cancelled, no-snap, and teardown paths are inert.
architecture.caster: Only the state owning event.castId queues the existing Gold applyExternalExchange path; Gold performs the authored snap once and restores actual POST roots. The adapter never relocates gameplay bodies.
architecture.receiver: A participating Mirror with a different a2CastId invokes Gold rebaseExternalExchangeHistory synchronously in the real event callback. That operation changes Gold history only; the ordinary adapter tick then consumes pendingExchange and syncs POST roots. It does not begin A2, snap, create residue, or tick Gold solely for rebase.
architecture.coalescedMvM: The real resolver commits one coordinate swap before emitting both coalesced notices, but the shared result's PRE pair is oriented to the first requester. Presentation reconstructs the unordered PRE pair from the opposite committed POST roots for coalesced notices, so both cast IDs/perspectives reach Gold with the same physical PRE/POST key.
architecture.dedupe: Gold remains authoritative for the unordered actor-pair plus PRE/POST physical key. The adapter adds no physical-key cache/dedupe; same-physical replay is rejected by Gold, while a later distinct PRE/POST exchange rebases.
architecture.historyLaw: Gold Float32Array HN=64, HS=22; every sample shifts root channels [0,1] by local-root delta and [20,21] by its inverse, all other channels stay unchanged, and exchange methods leave hHead unchanged.
